mcq.s: The slowest Internet connection service is –
mcq.x: Dial-up over a telephone line and modem gives at most about 56 Kbps, the slowest of these.

mcq.s: The first page that you normally view at any website is known as the
mcq.x: The home page is the first (main) page a browser shows on opening a website; it links to the site's other pages.

mcq.s: ______ is not a common network topology.
mcq.x: Common topologies are bus, star, ring, tree, mesh and hybrid; grid is not one of them.

mcq.s: The Internet system uses which of the following topologies (as per the exam key)?
mcq.x: The key takes the Internet as a tree (hierarchical bus-star) topology; strictly it is the largest hybrid network.

mcq.s: The Internet works on:
mcq.x: The Internet breaks data into packets that travel independently and are reassembled: packet switching.

mcq.s: A database that contains the names and addresses of various hosts on the Internet is called:
mcq.x: The Domain Name System (DNS) is the naming database that translates host/domain names into IP addresses.

mcq.s: What is the difference between Bluetooth and Wi-Fi devices?
o: Bluetooth uses 2.4 GHz radio frequency band, whereas Wi-Fi can use 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz frequency band
Bluetooth is used for Wireless Local Area Networks (WLAN) only, whereas Wi-Fi is used for Wireless Wide Area Networks (WWAN) only

When information is transmitted between two devices using Bluetooth technology, the devices have to be in the line of sight of each other, but when Wi-Fi technology is used the devices need not be in the line of sight of each other
The statements (a) and (b) given above are correct in this context
mcq.x: Bluetooth works in the 2.4 GHz band (personal area networks), while Wi-Fi uses 2.4 or 5 GHz (WLAN); neither needs line of sight.

mcq.s: What is a 'Virtual Private Network'?
o: It is a private computer network of an organisation where the remote users can transmit encrypted information through the server of the organisation
It is a computer network across a public internet that provides users access to their organisation's network while maintaining the security of the information transmitted
It is a computer network in which users can access a shared pool of computing resources through a service provider
None of the statements (a), (b) and (c) given above is a correct description of Virtual Private Network
mcq.x: A VPN extends a private network across the public internet through an encrypted tunnel; a shared pool of computing resources describes cloud computing.

mcq.s: A .......... offers services such as search capabilities, e-mail, news, stock prices, weather information, sports and entertainment.
mcq.x: A web portal (e.g. Yahoo, MSN) is a gateway site bringing search, e-mail, news and other services together.

mcq.s: Which type of computers are the most widely used?
mcq.x: Microcomputers (desktops, laptops, tablets, smartphones) are the most widely used computers.

mcq.s: Which type of computer could be found in a digital watch?
mcq.x: An embedded computer performs a dedicated function inside a larger device, such as a digital watch.

mcq.s: Which of the following lasers is used in laser printers?
mcq.x: Laser printers (and CD/DVD players) use semiconductor (diode) lasers; excimer lasers are ultraviolet lasers used in microelectronics.

mcq.s: Which printer is usually used for desktop printing (desktop publishing)?
mcq.x: Laser printers, fast non-impact printers with sharp output, are the standard for desktop publishing.

mcq.s: A daisy wheel printer is a type of –
mcq.x: The daisy wheel printer (David S. Lee, 1969) is an impact printer, like the dot-matrix printer.

mcq.s: WWW on the Internet stands for –
mcq.x: WWW (W3) is the World Wide Web, the system of linked hypertext documents accessed over the internet.

mcq.s: The World Wide Web (WWW) is a hypermedia system because –
o: It links to other computer resources
It can be used only to bring in video material
mcq.x: The Web is hypermedia because its documents link (hyperlinks) to other resources – text, images, video – on other computers.

mcq.s: The collection of linked information residing on computers which is available through the Internet is called
mcq.x: The World Wide Web is the collection of linked hypertext documents on computers, available through the internet.

mcq.s: In the field of the Internet, W3C stands for:
mcq.x: W3C is the World Wide Web Consortium, the main standards body for the Web, founded in 1994 by Tim Berners-Lee.

mcq.s: Which one of the following is not an infotech terminology?
mcq.x: Cyberspace, upload and modem are infotech terms; the key treats optical storage as a computer-engineering term.

mcq.s: Which one of the following is not an infotech terminology?
mcq.x: Pinaka is a DRDO-developed multiple rocket launcher; login, modem and password are IT terms.

mcq.s: Which one of the following is a part of infotech terminology?
mcq.x: Protocol (rules for communication), login (access credentials) and Archie (early FTP search tool) are all IT terms.

mcq.s: A set of rules that governs data communication is called:
mcq.x: A protocol is the set of rules (syntax, semantics, timing) that governs data communication between devices.

mcq.s: The set of protocols which defines all transmission exchanges across the Internet is called
mcq.x: TCP/IP is the internet protocol suite; CSMA/CD is an Ethernet access method and FDDI a fibre ring LAN standard.

mcq.s: In the OSI model, the layer between the Physical layer and the Network layer is the
mcq.x: OSI layers from the bottom: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application.

mcq.s: In a network environment, which of the following is not a (type of) server, as per the exam key?
mcq.x: File, print and application servers are server types; the key treats 'network server' as the generic term, not a type.

mcq.x: Yahoo, Google and MSN are internet websites (search engines/portals).

mcq.x: Yahoo is a search engine/web portal; Internet Explorer (now Edge), Firefox and Chrome are browsers.

mcq.x: Google Apps is a productivity suite; Opera, Vivaldi and Firefox are web browsers.
